options.name: Shell Beach Coastal Adventure Kayak Tour

services.name: Guided Kayak Fishing | Freshwater
services.desc: Unleash your inner angler on our Kayaking Fishing Tour! Our local lakes, brimming after recent rains, are teeming with bass, crappie, trout, and catfish eager to fight for your lure. Fish with us as you glide effortlessly across the water on pedal kayaks. Leave the gear to us! We'll provide everything you need for a successful day on the water, including rods, reels, tackle, and kayaking equipment (fishing license and $12 lake entry fee not included). Ready to cast off and conquer the catch of the day? Join us on this unforgettable kayak fishing Ages 12+ • 4 Hours • Our guided fishing trips are great for beginners and experienced anglers alike.

services.name: Kayak Fishing Rental
services.desc: Rent our stable and versatile kayak for a half-day (4 hours) of fishing fun starting at $100. We've got everything you need to make your fishing trip a success. We've got you covered from essential gear like descending devices and paddles to optional extras like fish grips and measuring boards. Whether you're a seasoned angler or a beginner, our kayak rental is the perfect way to explore the waters and reel in your Kayak Fishing rental + fishing gear

services.name: Ocean Adventure Camp
services.desc: Let’s have an adventure along our beautiful beaches and coastline this summer! Participants will learn how to use a stand-up paddle board (SUP), paddle a kayak, and boogie board all while exploring some of the hidden beaches, rocky shores, and ocean coves of our central coast! Have fun while learning a new skill this summer, and make some new friends while you’re at it! Our instructors are trained and certified by the American Canoe Association, First Aid/CPR certified, lifeguard trained, and just really cool people. Make this summer one to remember! All equipment is A great way to play-for kids 10 to 14yrs old

services.name: Cave Excursion
services.desc: 3 Hours About This is our most exciting and rewarding tour!!! The Cave Excursion is enjoyed by novice and seasoned kayakers alike. There are a series of arches, caves, and rock gardens that are only accessible from the water and your kayak is the best vehicle for exploring. This tour is exhilarating and at times strenuous. Your guide will instruct and assist you with a surf zone launch. Once passed the breakers you will venture along spectacular coastal vistas, grottoes, arches, kelp forests, and protected coves to the Dinosaur Caves, our marine playground. This tour can be taken by Ages 12+ • 3 Hours • This is our most exciting and rewarding tour!

services.name: Morro Bay Wildlife Tour
services.desc: 2 Hours About The Morro Bay wildlife tour is a great flatwater paddling experience for ages 7+ with an adult in a tandem. Great for families and folks who enjoy to do more sightseeing than adventuring. Often we see harbor seals, California sea lions, sea otters and many different types of birds that use Morro Bay as a stop over on the Pacific Flyway migration route. Let our trained naturalists share the beauty of this recognized National Estuary, abundant wildlife and the "Gibralter" of the pacific, Morro Rock. Availability Everyday Everyone must have the ability to swim## Minimum Ages 8+ • 2 Hours • A calm paddle with beautiful wildlife!

services.name: Guided Kayak Fishing | Saltwater
services.desc: 4 Hours About Our guided fishing trips are great for beginners and experienced anglers alike. The waters along the Central Coast offer a wonderfully diverse fishery. Our guides have been fishing these waters for years and can help get you on the fish. The fishing season along the Central Coast generally runs from April 1st thru December 31st, with the best conditions between June and October. Whether you have your own kayak and gear or need to rent some of ours, our experienced guides are happy to hit the water with you. The fishing in our local waters is usually very good with Ages 12+ • 4 Hours • Our guided fishing trips are great for beginners and experienced anglers alike.

services.name: Water Rentals
services.desc: We offer a variety of rentals to suit your preferences: Solo Kayak: Perfect for individual exploration. Tandem Kayak: Ideal for a leisurely paddle with a friend or family member. Stand-Up Paddleboard (SUP): Enjoy a unique perspective on the water while strengthening your core and balance. Rental Details: Pick-Up: If you can pick up and transport your rental, you can do so anytime we're open. Ocean Conditions: Rentals are subject to ocean conditions. Safety First: All renters must be able to swim. Age Requirements: The minimum age is 12 years old for a tandem rental (accompanied by an adult) Experience the ocean on your own terms on a kayak or SUP

services.name: Accessory Rental
services.desc: Are you craving some outdoor fun but missing the essential gear? Look no further! We've got you covered with a fantastic selection of equipment ready to rent. From Boogie Boards and Wetsuits to Fishing Kits, we've got something for every thrill-seeker. Can't find exactly what you need? Don't sweat it! Call us, and let's work together to make your dream adventure a reality. We're here to help you create unforgettable memories! Everything but the kayak!

services.name: Pickleball Lesson
services.desc: Learn the basics to advanced skills for this fun and easy-to-play sport. We provide all the equipment needed and use certified instructors to elevate your Have fun with Pickleball

services.name: Intro to Standup Paddling (SUP)
services.desc: Standup paddleboarding or SUP is one of the fastest-growing sports in the nation and for good reason. SUP is a wonderful way to get out on the water, is acceptable for all skill levels and ages, and is great exercise too. All while having fun! If you have wanted to try SUP but weren't sure where to start our introductory class is perfect. This is a really fun course to take with a group of friends. Our instructors will teach you basic paddling techniques, on water safety, and will get you on your way toward your newfound paddling addiction, Ages 12+ • 1.5 Hours • Learn to SUP with us!

services.name: Intro to Kayaking
services.desc: introductory course for sit-on-top (open deck) kayaks is a recreation-based course and introduces students to basic paddling strokes, solo and assisted rescues, launching and landing, and general kayaking technique and safety on the protected waters along our beautiful coastline. If you are looking for a fun place to start your paddling career or just want to see what sit-on-top kayaking is about, this class is for Ages 12+ • 1.5 Hours • Start your paddling adventure!

services.name: Intro to Kayaking II
services.desc: This class is for paddlers who have participated in our [Cave Excursion Tour](https://centralcoastkayaks.com/activities/cave-excursion/) or our [Intro to Kayaking](https://fareharbor.com/embeds/book/centralcoastkayaks/items/23617/?full-items=yes/) Class and is focused on refining your paddling skills like your paddling technique, maintaining momentum, and capsize 16+ • 1.5 Hours • Great way to refine your kayak skills

services.name: Kayak Rescue Class
services.desc: Our kayak rescue class is designed to help each paddler prepare and practice when things go bad. Deep water-assisted rescues, towing injured paddlers, how to handle a swamped kayak and more will be practiced. This is a hands-on, get-wet course! Please bring or rent a wetsuit and bring whatever safety gear you currently have. First aid, VHF radio protocol, and injured paddler scenarios will be Ages 16+ • For when things don't go as planned

services.name: Kayak Fishing Safety Class
services.desc: Our kayak fishing safety class is designed to provide the kayak fisherman with the opportunity to learn how to launch and land through surf, paddle effectively and efficiently, re-enter their kayak in deep water, learn how to assist others back in their kayak after a capsize, tow an injured or tired paddler and much more. This is a great class for the beginner as well as the seasoned kayak fisherman. All gear is included; wetsuit, paddle jacket, booties, kayak, seat , paddle, tow ropes, pumps and paddle Ages 12+ • 2 Hours
